claims.claim_text: The F-35 Lightning II is Hexcel's largest defense program, representing less than 25% of revenues in the Defense, Space & Other market segment in 2025.
claims.subject: Hexcel
claims.object_value: F-35 program — <25% of Defense, Space & Other (39% of total) → approx <9.75% of total 2025 net sales (~<$185M of $1,893.9M)
claims.source_quote: We are qualified to supply materials to a broad range of military aircraft, commercial helicopter and space programs, including the Lockheed Martin F-35 (Lightning)... The F-35, which is our largest program, represents less than 25% of revenues in this market.

claims.claim_text: Hexcel supplies advanced composites for the Sikorsky CH-53K King Stallion heavy-lift transport helicopter program, characterized as a growth program in 2025.
claims.subject: Hexcel
claims.object_value: CH-53K King Stallion — growth program in 2025; led Defense, Space & Other +5.4% YoY growth alongside Black Hawk
claims.source_quote: CH-53K is a growth program, including the composite helicopter blades and new helicopter programs in development which use Hexcel composites in prototypes... Year over year growth was led by military helicopters, including the Black Hawk and CH-53-K

claims.subject: Hexcel

claims.claim_text: Hexcel sees strong demand in the defense and space market as global defense budgets continue to increase, with 2025 Defense, Space & Other sales of $747.0M growing 5.4% YoY driven by helicopters, military aircraft structures, launchers, and satellites.
claims.subject: Hexcel
claims.object_value: Defense, Space & Other = 39% of 2025 sales = $747M; +5.4% YoY growth driven by Black Hawk, CH-53K, European fighter, launchers, satellites
claims.source_quote: we see positive indicators for a sustained recovery in commercial aircraft production and strong demand in the defense and space market as global defense budgets continue to increase... Defense, Space & Other sales in 2025 increased 5.4% compared to 2024. Year over year growth was led by military helicopters, including the Black Hawk and CH-53-K, as well as other military aircraft structures, launchers and satellites.

claims.claim_text: Hexcel composites are used on the Dassault Rafale fighter, Airbus A400M, and Embraer KC-390 military transport aircraft (a European fighter program contributed to 2025 Defense growth).

claims.object_value: Dassault Rafale + A400M + KC-390 international military transports/fighters
claims.source_quote: We are qualified to supply materials to a broad range of military aircraft... Dassault Rafale, Airbus A400M and Embraer KC-390 military transport aircraft... Defense, Space & Other sales in 2025 increased 5.4% ... including the Black Hawk, CH-53K, and a European fighter program

claims.claim_text: Space applications for Hexcel composites include solid rocket booster cases, fairings, and payload doors for both government-funded and commercial launch vehicles, and satellite bus / solar arrays. Launchers and satellites contributed materially to 2025 Defense, Space & Other growth.
claims.subject: Hexcel
claims.object_value: Space launch vehicles (SRB cases, fairings, payload doors) + military and commercial satellites
claims.source_quote: Space applications for advanced composites include solid rocket booster cases, fairings and payload doors for both government funded and commercial launch vehicles, and satellite buss and solar arrays for military and commercial satellites... Defense, Space & Other sales for 2025 increased by 2.5% over the prior year primarily driven by higher sales of launchers.
